name: person_id
description: A foreign key identifier to the person for whom the data was recorded.

name: sleep_date
description: The date the sleep log ended.

name: sleep_log_type
description: The type of sleep in terms of how it was logged. Supported: auto_detected | manual

name: total_sleep_records
description: The number of sleep records within the sleep log.

name: sleep_duration
description: Length of the sleep in milliseconds.

name: total_minute_asleep
description: summary : totalMinutesAsleep Total number of minutes the user was asleep across all sleep records in the sleep log.

name: total_time_in_bed
description: summary : totalTimeInBed Total number of minutes the user was in bed across all records in the sleep log.

name: sleep_start_time
description: sleep : startTime Time the sleep log begins.

name: sleep_end_time
description: sleep : endTime Time the sleep log ended.

name: sleep_info_code
description: sleep : infoCode An integer value representing the quality of data collected within the sleep log. 0 = Sufficient data to generate a sleep log. 1 = Insufficient heart rate data. 2 = Sleep period was too short (less than 3 hours). 3 = Server-side issue when generating the sleep log. No data impact.

name: is_main_sleep
description: Defines a record as being the 'main sleep' record. Boolean value: true or false.

name: sleep_type
description: The type of sleep log. Supported : classic | stages.

name: src_id
description: Flag indicating the participant portal that this record originated from.
